name: Type A-3 Life Raft with Survivors
blurb: A Hangar-only five-person raft group with survivors isolated as removable review nodes.
history: The Type A-3 was a five-person aircraft life raft associated with Wright Field specification 40420-A. Its official identity and carried equipment are documented; the inflated shape and survivor poses in this group are estimates.

sources.title: U.S. Government Publications Catalog, Wright Field specification 40420-A
Federal Register, Type A-3 five-man life raft equipment
